proofs.race_free:
by
  refine ⟨finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · have h : (finalState unitOps (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())).trace = traceData := rfl
    rw [h]
    decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · have h : (finalState ops input outside).trace = traceData := rfl
    rw [h]
    decide
  · rfl
